purpose: Explain vehicle driving ratings through independent server assessment and locally computed scored-drive evidence.
primaryGoal: Review overall grade, category scores, trends, distribution, improvement advice, history, period averages and achievements without losing source context.

routeEvidence.detail: drive-score route mounts DriveScore inside SafeRoute.
Route participates in header-owned range scope.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: driveHandler.ListByVehicle; API drive sessions, then page-local heuristic scoring
dataSources.behavior: Enabled with selected vehicle; abort signal forwarded; safeArray selector; existing fast stale policy. Page supplies neither server date bounds nor pagination options.
dataSources.backendLimits: Hook documentation describes a default 50-row page and cap 1000. Actual backend implementation was not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed query, enabled with selected vehicle, abort signal forwarded, retry:false; no date arguments or range query key.
dataSources.backendLimits: Score computation, coverage and backend date support are unknown; route existence is source-confirmed, not runtime acceptance.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing header workspace and saved display preferences
dataSources.behavior: Selected vehicle is consumed without duplicate picker. Range consumes calendar start/end instead of canonical instants. SI inputs remain meters, seconds, Wh, W and m/s; efficiency is derived for display.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Shared metric bridge; caller owns scored-cohort raw metrics and specialist efficiency formatter
dataSources.behavior: Four operational metrics preserve null readings, scope, provenance and retained/error status.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Legacy four-StatCard KPI renderer remains alongside mounted ScoreEvidenceBrief; mounted page imports the latter. ScoreEvidenceBrief uses the former only for its props type.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain metric parity and use the mounted OperationalBrief path; move the type contract to a neutral page model if removing the unmounted renderer after caller verification.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Hero/charts/tips stack until xl; category cards 1/2/3 columns; extremes 1/2/4 columns; period tiles 2/3/6; achievements auto-fill; several min-w-0 wrappers.

issues.detail: Mobile allow-list retains date, score, grade only. Route, distance, duration, consumption and category breakdown have no page-supplied mobile details adapter or row expansion. DataTable.tsx:725 hides excluded cells below md.
issues.fix: Opt into existing DataTable.mobilePresentation with all omitted fields in details, retaining stable tableId, ordering, loaded-row export and pagination. Do not create a second table engine.

issues.detail: Two-column period grid is unconditional at 320px; category chart also reserves 110px for labels. Long translated labels and 200% text require checking rather than assuming fit.
issues.fix: Exercise assigned widths and long labels; adjust only confirmed clipping using existing responsive/card conventions and preserve all six tiles.

sourceStrengths: Refresh has localized aria-label; decorative icons generally aria-hidden.
Named sections and shared typography are used.
Charts supply localized ariaLabel and typed table data columns.
Shared SourceContent loading body has role=status.

issues.detail: Comparison delta is absolute; up/down icons are aria-hidden and only color conveys direction. An assistive technology user receives the same positive delta for improvement and decline.
issues.fix: Provide localized signed/directional comparison text or accessible label through existing typography, keeping both current and previous values.

states.initialLoading: Independent per-section Skeleton via SourceContent; four-metric brief loading derives from drive source.
states.empty: Persistent shells and localized EmptyState; no vehicle shows explicit header selection notice.
states.fatalError: Independent score-source retry and history fallback; one source does not suppress successful neighbor.
states.retained: useDataState distinguishes fatalError/refreshError; StaleRefreshWarning for both sources; brief retained flag uses drive source.
states.partial: Notice identifies excluded unscorable drives; scoreDrive rejects missing/nonfinite/negative required evidence.
states.offline: Shared DataState contract retains paused data as stale; actual offline UI not exercised.

issues.detail: Missing independent server trend defaults to flat, subsequently labeled Stable, even when history alone supplies a score. Unknown trend is presented as measured stability.
issues.fix: Retain independent source context and show unknown/unavailable trend when server trend is missing; do not fabricate a local trend.

issues.detail: Header Refresh calls only drives refetch although the page shows both independent query sources and a combined freshness badge.
issues.fix: Refresh both existing enabled sources, preserving independent retention and retry behavior; avoid requests without a selected vehicle.

visualIssues.detail: A+ dynamic gauge/trend color explicitly uses fluorescent #39ff14; category colors and histogram ranges also define fixed local palettes. Dynamic-fill exemption from inline-style lint is not design-contract acceptance.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained chart/semantic tokens for default grade/category/bin roles; preserve grade thresholds, labels and saved explicit chart color preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Capacity backdrop uses fixed dark #1e293b with opacity, not a semantic theme surface.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing neutral chart/surface tokens while retaining the capacity series and numeric max export.

architectureIssues.detail: Range-owning /drive-score fetches unbounded default drive page then filters locally. Score query is vehicle-only. Selected range does not bound server results or independent aggregate; wider ranges can silently miss history.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass canonical range instants to existing typed drive window, load complete bounded analysis coverage using existing pagination patterns, and separately establish date-bound server score support. Keep independent source provenance; never claim currently unknown endpoint support.

architectureIssues.detail: Date-only new Date parsing plus fixed 86400000 and <= upper bound bypasses useRangeState canonical timezone/rolling instants; boundary handling cannot preserve rolling 24h or DST semantics.
architectureIssues.fix: Use startInstant/endInstantExclusive from existing workspace owner and exclusive end filtering, consistently through server and derived cohorts.

architectureIssues.detail: Week start retains current time-of-day; lastMonthEnd is midnight at start of last day and inclusive comparison excludes most of that day. Calendar buckets use browser-local dates, not explicit workspace timezone.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain weekly/monthly metrics but use existing calendar/timezone utilities and exclusive next-period boundaries; verify period membership with boundary cases.

architectureIssues.detail: Achievement count predicates describe scored drives but receive filteredDrives including unscorable drives, whereas score predicates receive allScores. Counts can unlock with fewer scored drives than advertised.
architectureIssues.fix: Make displayed eligibility/source cohort explicit and align count inputs with the existing scored-drive descriptions, preserving every achievement and threshold.

architectureIssues.detail: Help describes acceleration/braking/cornering and tunability, but inspected local scoreDomain uses average power, max speed and energy intensity. Backend score/settings support was not inspected, so this cannot be asserted as the fallback heuristic.
architectureIssues.fix: Distinguish independent server assessment from local heuristic and provide truthful source-specific explanations; verify backend capabilities before retaining unsupported help claims.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Date-bounded independent score assessment and complete drive coverage
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse DriveWindow start/end/limit and abort signal; add score range/query-key parameters only after backend support is established. Preserve vehicle enablement, retry policy, empty/fatal/retained states and independent cohorts.
dependsOn: driveHandler.Score date filtering capability is unverified
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Integration-owned contract work; no shared source edited

requiredSharedChanges.name: Complete mobile history details
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing mobilePresentation/details or expandable/renderExpanded presentation must expose route, distance, duration, consumption and category breakdown while retaining date/score/grade summary, tableId, loaded exports, sort and pagination.
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Reuse existing shared contract; no new shared primitive justified

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained semantic chart defaults
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse chartTokens and existing color owner for grade/category/range hues, neutral capacity background, missing readings and theme-aware defaults; do not reset persisted explicit palette preferences.
dependsOn: Existing tokens/colors owner; page local dynamic colors
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Page adoption of existing palette; no new theme engine or shared edit requested

competingImplementations.detail: Unmounted StatCard summary vs mounted ScoreEvidenceBrief; type-only dependency remains.
competingImplementations.fix: Retain the mounted OperationalBrief and neutralize the type-only legacy-renderer dependency after caller review.

competingImplementations.detail: Page-local calendar filtering competes with canonical workspace instant bounds.
competingImplementations.fix: Use canonical workspace instants through server and client coverage.

competingImplementations.detail: Local grade/category palette competes with shared chart/color defaults.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse shared restrained semantic/chart tokens without resetting saved choices.
